text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober seizes first place! And<n>with that...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's won the Triple Tiara! The<n>Mejiro family has
once again claimed<n>the glory of the Tiara! History
has<n>been made today!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I won... I won the Triple Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dobeeeer, you did it! Hic!Congratulations! You did so well!Thank you for that amazing race!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Dobeeer! You really, truly, absolutely<n>are the coolest
ever!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Dober! Dober! Dober! Dober! Dober!<n>Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I can't believe it! I'm so happy. I'm<n>so happy! Oh
no, I feel like I'm going<n>to start crying...)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
(Ramonu didn't cry, so I won't<n>either!)

(After all, I can hold my head up high<n>and be proud
too!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That was quite the race. You know...

It's hard to believe there would be<n>another Mejiro
racer who would be<n>able to seize all three of the
tiaras<n>after you.
Hehe... Yes, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The next time we meet, you and I will<n>be...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I go out to meet Mejiro Dober after<n>she returns,
amidst the crowd's<n>cheers. Her expression is
brimming<n>with satisfaction.
You too. Congrats.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Congratulations to you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Were you watching me out there? I<n>bet you didn't
even blink.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Were you watching me? Did you take<n>in the entire
race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What you witnessed was the Triple<n>Tiara we won
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What you witnessed was the Triple<n>Tiara we won
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I've said this before, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you for believing in my<n>strength, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We celebrate our victory together and<n>take a new
step toward our next<n>challenge!
